svg.title: D10 MRO and asset lifecycle
svg.text: INPUTS THAT OPEN OR INFORM WORK — NEVER BYPASS AUTHORISATION
user creates work order from signal
Gates: tasks complete → INSPECTION · RII by a second person · evidence ACCEPTED · READY = zero blockers
Every transition writes work_order.transitioned (audit). IN_PROGRESS → INSPECTION needs all tasks complete;
Return to service is a human determination outside LISA.
